figures.caption: Figure 1: Four evidence sources (Consensus, PubMed, Clinical trials, and Living SR) are retrieved in parallel and integrated through a synthesis module into a clinical response.

Figure 2: User-facing presentation of a curated synthesis response. (a) Generated responses begin with a section of Clinical Bottom Line and include inline citations. (b) A source-labeled reference list preserves provenance across evidence corpora. (c) Relevant ClinicalTrials.gov records are displayed as trial cards.
Table 1: GPT-4o evaluation of Long COVID responses from our chatbot and OpenEvidence. Values are mean ± SD across 50 questions. Higher scores indicate better performance.
